title: Selection criteria: quality, cost, latency, context and privacy

videos.script: Five criteria decide which model to use. Quality, cost, latency, context and privacy. They are not five scores to add up. {{matrix}} Some are thresholds. A model that fails one is not a worse candidate. It is not a candidate. The rest are trade-offs, and you rank by them only once the list holds models that could do the job. {{sheet}} So you write the thresholds down first, and filter the sheet with them. Three thousand entries become sixteen hundred. {{cost}} Then cost, priced as a workload. A long policy sent on every request costs a quarter as much once it is cached. {{latency}} Then latency, which is two numbers: the first token, and the whole reply. You measure each many times, and read the slowest one in twenty. {{empty}} At the end there is a table with one column still empty. Quality. Lesson five fills it.
